rationale: The EU Age Verification profile, and the ONLY internationally-defined age doctype Apple grants this account. That is the whole reason it exists: au.com.idpartners.proofofage.1 is ours, so no iPhone wallet can be entitled to provide it, and a credential the platform is never told about cannot appear in the picker however correct the request is. Carrying the same assertion under an international doctype is what makes proof-of-age reachable on iOS at all. The profile is identifiers-ONLY by design — age_over_NN booleans (01-99) and nothing else, no name, no portrait, no date of birth — which is also why this entry declares a single claim where the IDPartners one declares six. PROVENANCE: doctype and namespace are the same string, taken from a credential-profile catalogue rather than the EU rulebook itself, and nothing in this repo can check them. That pair is the first thing to re-verify if a well-formed request returns nothing, because a wrong namespace matches nothing and is indistinguishable from a wallet that does not hold the credential.
